scope: Official Shopify Broadcast:Motif preset listing View demo inspected read-only with rendered browser accessibility tree. Home, 117-product All collection, Checkered Tank PDP and empty cart inspected. No shopper actions, screenshot, measured viewport/mobile, editor, checkout, keyboard or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Broadcast:Motif listing View demo opened broadcast-motif.myshopify.com.

claims.observed: Home combines sale-led seasonal fashion storytelling and curated product rails; 117-item collection offers filters, sort and quick-add affordances with category structure.
claims.risk: No filters, sort or quick-add actions tested; promotion, stock and merchandising copy are seller content.
claims.vsn_guard: Maintain usable filters and sort choices across large collections and keep promotions and availability current.

claims.observed: Checkered Tank PDP shows size chart, color, fit, care and delivery content; empty cart links to Shop, Sale, Blog and About and shows recently viewed product context.
claims.risk: All observed sizes were labeled unavailable; fit/delivery/material claims are unverified.
claims.vsn_guard: Keep option availability synchronized with stock and place fit, delivery and return details close to product choices.
